description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5950015293922 TRANSFORMER,POWER: Line 0001 Qty 11 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0083 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
